name: Nanny from the Village
overview: Milica Radenović - Mica, a beautiful and naturally intelligent girl from the countryside, comes to Belgrade and instead of being a seller of mammals, becomes a nanny in the home of the seventh generation of Belgrade architects - the Maksimović family, led by Konstantin, a hardened widower who, five years after the death of his wife Vesna, still fails to establish proper communication with his three children. While Mica, with her rural way of thinking, Sinsay clothes, directness and folk wisdom, brings a revolution to the rigid Maksimović family, she herself undergoes a transformation.
